title: Bran Surprise Muffins
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F. Spray muffin pans with cooking spray; set aside.
Combine cream cheese, sugar, 2 tbsp flour, and vanilla extract in a small bowl; set aside. This filling mixture can be covered and refrigerated for up to 1 week.
Combine flour, sugar, cinnamon, baking soda, and salt in a large bowl. Stir in cereal.
Combine eggs, buttermilk, oil, and raisins. Add the egg mixture to the flour mixture, stirring just until moistened. This batter mixture can be covered and refrigerated for up to 1 week.

Spoon 1 heaping tbsp of batter into prepared muffin pans and top with 2 tsp of cream cheese mixture. Spoon 1 heaping tbsp of batter over filling, spreading to completely cover the filling. Repeat with remaining batter and filling.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Remove from pans immediately, and cool on wire racks.
notes: Recipe was changed to cut in half.
